title: Algebras with Variable Structural Constants and Their Applications
summary: We introduce a new class of algebras with variable structural constants and develop elements of the theory of monogenic functions in such algebras. Compatibility conditions for the structural functions are established. It is shown that the components of monogenic functions satisfy certain second-order partial differential equations with variable coefficients, and converse results are proved. This approach provides a constructive method for obtaining explicit solutions of such equations. Several illustrative examples are presented.
